shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -6 && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; sed -n '1,220p' package.json; rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by|describe\\('ToolRegistry|new ToolRegistry\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -40; rg -n '\"ajv\"' package-lock.json | head; test -d node_modules/ajv && echo ajv-present || true; git diff --stat; git branch --show-current"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg -n \"@spec|spec:\" src specs scripts --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.mjs' | head -80; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | nl -ba"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface ToolDefinition|type ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts | head -30; sed -n '110,165p' src/types/ai.ts; node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files scripts | rg 'spec.*(anchor|link|repoint|reanchor)'; sed -n '1,160p' scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs 2>/dev/null || true; git diff -- package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md package.json | sed -n '1,260p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Validate missing required tool input" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
